'''Kello''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kello was among a group of couriers that were sent by the criminal [[Vex (Human)|Vex]] to collect an illicit cargo from the jungles of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Kello flew a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] to the rendezvous point where they were collecting the cargo, but no-one was there to meet the couriers and Kello became nervous. They were then attacked by a group of enforcers who were working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]]. The enforcers detonated some [[thermal mine]]s and Kello swerved his swoop to avoid the blast from one. However, he was killed moments later by a volley of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, which shattered the body [[Armor/Legends|armor]] he was wearing.
